verdict.rationale: Qodo documents a way to push back: you can discuss or dismiss a finding, or chat with it in the PR. It also has its own learning mechanism: PR History learns from your team's pull request activity, Relevance scores how likely a finding is to matter based on how similar findings were handled before, and Rule Miner generates rules from PR history. The docs show learning only as relevance scoring, though, and never say a dismissed finding is suppressed or stops recurring. missing for 10: explicit documentation that dismissing or rejecting a comment suppresses that feedback in future reviews, per-developer pushback feedback loop details, independent or hands-on corroboration that repeated rejected feedback actually stops
